description: My name is Vaibhav Asvin, and I am very interested in space. At the moment, I am a pretty decent mathematician and coder. We have already built our team, and we are no longer looking for another new member. Our other member is named Sachin Shankar, and he is an avid astronomer, and has a lot of knowledge about space. He too, is quite astonished at the prospect of the space outside of the Earth.
